learningObjectives: Explain the physiological or methodological basis of Interictal Epileptiform Discharges.
Apply Interictal Epileptiform Discharges to technically valid clinical interpretation.
Identify artifacts, confounds and limits that could alter conclusions.
Communicate findings without exceeding the evidence or professional scope.

mechanismMap.label: Core concept
mechanismMap.detail: Epileptiform discharges have characteristic morphology, field and disruption of background, but benign transients can mimic them.

mechanismMap.label: Mechanism
mechanismMap.detail: Specificity depends on expert visual interpretation. Absence does not exclude epilepsy, and presence must be integrated with clinical history.

mechanismMap.label: Clinical integration
mechanismMap.detail: Supports epilepsy classification and treatment decisions when interpreted by trained clinicians.

mechanismMap.label: Boundary condition
mechanismMap.detail: Automated spike detection produces false positives if accepted uncritically.

reviewPrompts.answer: Specificity depends on expert visual interpretation. Absence does not exclude epilepsy, and presence must be integrated with clinical history.
Supports epilepsy classification and treatment decisions when interpreted by trained clinicians.
Automated spike detection produces false positives if accepted uncritically.
Epilepsy is a clinical diagnosis informed—not replaced—by EEG.
